test.create_query: CREATE TABLE fixed_key (tenant String, k UInt32, v UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO fixed_key SELECT ['tenant_a', 'tenant_b'][number % 2 + 1], intHash32(number) % 1000000, number FROM numbers_mt(20000000)
test.query: SELECT tenant, k, count() FROM fixed_key WHERE tenant = 'tenant_a' GROUP BY tenant, k FORMAT Null
SELECT max(rn) FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant, k ORDER BY v) AS rn FROM fixed_key WHERE tenant = 'tenant_a') FORMAT Null
